scheme_name: Nirmaan Shramik Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana
other_conditions: Must be a construction worker aged between 18 and 60 years.
Must be registered as a beneficiary under Section 12 of the Building and Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment and Service Conditions) Act, 1996.
Death must not be caused by suicide, consumption of drugs or substances, criminal act, intentional physical violence, or riots.
Benefit is payable only on the death of the registered worker, not on the death of family members.
Beneficiaries already receiving assistance under the Financial Assistance and Rehabilitation Assistance Scheme for construction workers suffering from silicosis are ineligible.
benefits_summary: Provides Rs 1 Lakhs on normal death, Rs 5 Lakhs on death at work site, and Rs 2.5 Lakhs for permanent disability at work site.
